purpose: Characterize why the preregistered modern roster-universe V1 rule failed without relaxing any count threshold or assigning any replacement game-day membership labels. The diagnostic quantifies whether adding Did Not Play identities to Lineups plus Substitutions creates direct contradictions with frozen official era active-roster maxima and records the exact DNP-only identities requiring independent eligibility evidence.

diagnostic_sets.lineups_plus_substitutions_union: set union of exact Game Book parser identities printed in Lineups and Substitutions; diagnostic only and not authorized as a positive-label universe
diagnostic_sets.did_not_play_only: Did Not Play parser identities not already present in Lineups plus Substitutions
diagnostic_sets.v1_active_candidate_union: Lineups plus Substitutions plus Did Not Play exact parser-identity set union
diagnostic_sets.not_active: Game Book Not Active exact parser-identity set
diagnostic_sets.v1_roster_candidate_union: v1 active candidate union plus Not Active

contradiction_logic.active_max_contradiction: Lineups plus Substitutions union is at or below the frozen era active maximum while adding DNP-only identities makes the V1 active candidate union exceed that maximum.
contradiction_logic.minimum_dnp_non_active_required_by_activ: max(0, v1_active_candidate_count - era_active_max) when lineups_plus_substitutions_count <= era_active_max; diagnostic lower bound only.
contradiction_logic.total_roster_max_contradiction: V1 roster candidate union exceeds the frozen era active/inactive list maximum.

required_outputs: active-max contradiction partitions and exact DNP-only identities
minimum DNP non-active lower bound for each active-max contradiction
exact replay of all seven V1 failed team partitions
bounded examples for non-contradictory DNP-only partitions
